reviews.reason: The issue proposes a reward after solution PR #16032 already exists; another claimant is present and no funded payout mechanism is verified.

The claim already has open solution PR #89; there is no distinct unassigned task to prove.

The implementation scope is clear but no personal reward or payable amount is established.
The source explicitly says all ten slots are filled and the bounty is delivered; two solution PRs are also open.
The proposal body names existing solution PR #16034; a later claimant explicitly withdrew to avoid competing.
The proposal is for work already delivered in PR #17269, with an additional competing PR #17283.
The claimant already opened solution PR #95.
The single 50-USDC award is assigned and accepted for another contributor; the issue remains open only for unpaid settlement reconciliation.
Automated maintainer triage requires a maintainer licensing/scope decision, a valid bounty Claim ID and a local integration run; no funded personal award is established.
